---
title: "Setup"
subtitle: "Do this before the first session — it takes about 30 minutes"
---

Setup problems take a long time to fix during class, so please get ready **before** the first session. Each checklist ends with a **test**: if it prints the expected answer, you're ready.

## Before Session 1 (one-time setup)

1.  **Install R** (version 4.2 or newer) from [CRAN](https://cran.r-project.org/).
2.  **Install Positron** (free) from [Posit](https://positron.posit.co/download.html). Positron is the program you write and run R code in. Install R first (step 1), then Positron.
3.  **Download the workshop folder:** [download the ZIP file](https://github.com/CWML/CWML-R-Hands-on-Workshop-Series/archive/refs/heads/main.zip) and unzip it somewhere easy to find (Documents, not Downloads). This one download has everything for all eight sessions.
4.  **Open the workshop folder in Positron:** open Positron, choose **File → Open Folder...**, select the unzipped `CWML-R-Hands-on-Workshop-Series` folder, and click **Open**. If Positron asks whether you trust the authors of the files, click **Yes**.
    -   The workshop files appear in the **Explorer** on the left.
    -   An R **Console** starts at the bottom. If it doesn't, click the interpreter button in the top-right corner and choose R.
5.  **Install the packages.** Copy this into the **Console** (bottom) and press Enter:

    ``` r
    install.packages(c("tidyverse", "here", "rio", "janitor", "skimr", "gtsummary", "flextable", "scales"))
    ```

    It can take 5–10 minutes. If you see errors about compilers, see [Troubleshooting](troubleshooting.qmd).

6.  **Test it.** Copy this into the Console and press Enter:

    ``` r
    library(tidyverse); library(here); library(rio); library(janitor); library(skimr); library(gtsummary); library(flextable)
    nrow(import(here("raw_data", "measles_raw.csv")))
    ```

::: callout-tip
## ✅ You're ready if it prints `[1] 1215`

Red messages that don't start with "Error" are normal. If you see an error, contact the instructor before the session.
:::

::: callout-note
## Already use RStudio?

That works too. Install the packages the same way, and open the workshop by double-clicking `CWML-R-Hands-on-Workshop-Series.Rproj` instead of using Open Folder. Everything else in the workshop is the same. (In RStudio, Positron's **Variables** pane is called **Environment**, and the **Explorer** is the **Files** pane.)
:::

## Before every session (2 minutes)

-   Open the workshop **folder** in Positron (**File → Open Recent** lists it) — not a script on its own
-   Open that session's student script from the `student_scripts/` folder
-   Run that session's test:

| Session | Bring / have ready | Test (copy into the Console) | ✅ Ready if it prints |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | The one-time setup above | See above | `[1] 1215` |
| 2 | Your measles problem list from Session 1 | `nrow(rio::import(here::here("raw_data", "linelist_raw.xlsx")))` | `[1] 6604` |
| 3 | — | `nrow(rio::import(here::here("processed_data", "linelist_clean.rds"), trust = TRUE))` | `[1] 6604` |
| 4 | — | `nrow(rio::import(here::here("processed_data", "combined_linelist.rds"), trust = TRUE))` | `[1] 6451` |
| 5 | — | `nrow(rio::import(here::here("processed_data", "measles_final.rds"), trust = TRUE))` | `[1] 1163` |
| 6 | — | `nrow(rio::import(here::here("processed_data", "measles_final.rds"), trust = TRUE))` | `[1] 1163` |
| 7 | — | `dir.exists(here::here("outputs"))` | `[1] TRUE` |
| 8 | — | `purrr::map_dbl(1:3, ~ .x * 2)` | `[1] 2 4 6` |

::: callout-note
## Missed a session, or did your saved file break?

Every file a session starts from is already in the `processed_data/` folder. When you save your own version in class, it replaces that copy. If yours stops working, download the workshop folder again and copy the file back into `processed_data/`.
:::

::: callout-note
## Bringing your own data?

Put the file in the `raw_data/` folder before the session. Every lesson ends with a ⭐ BONUS for your own data.
:::

## What's in the workshop folder

```
CWML-R-Hands-on-Workshop-Series/
├── CWML-R-Hands-on-Workshop-Series.Rproj   # only needed if you use RStudio
├── student_scripts/  # student scripts, one per session
├── solutions/        # the student scripts with every answer filled in
├── raw_data/         # the original data files (never edit these!)
├── processed_data/   # cleaned data saved during the sessions
└── outputs/          # plots and tables you save
```
